title: The Morning Circuit — Wednesday, June 03, 2026
description: Top stories: GitLab cuts 14% of staff as it scales its platform to serve AI workloads; Publishers will be able to opt out of AI Search, thanks to new regulation; Dreame’s L20 Ultra robovac is an unbeatable deal for $280; Pokémon Champions hits iOS and Android on June 17; TikTok launches TikTok Pro Events, an app for cultural moments like the FIFA World Cup.
